clusters.name: deterministic-assertions
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 only strengthens existing inline #[cfg(test)] modules with no network and no new file, so it is independent of the capstone and ships the gated no-network acceptance criteria first; it can even run in parallel with US-002 since it touches disjoint files.

clusters.name: capstone
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-002 (chat-SSE harness in core/tests/common/chat_sse.rs + COPILOT_API_HOME token-cache fixture + lib.rs/Cargo.toml registration) and US-003 (the multi-turn wiremock test_codex e2e at core/tests/suite/chat_completions.rs that consumes them) share the new harness and the process-global anthropic gates; US-003 cannot compile until US-002 lands, so they MUST serialize. dependsOn deterministic-assertions is an ordering preference (US-001 should land first to de-risk), not a hard code dependency. NOTE: recommended home is core/tests/suite (patch-surface invariant-37 location, no dependency cycle, no preflight); the overlay leaf crate codex-copilot-e2e-tests is the documented alternative.
